units.headline: Add isolation.committedAppendID returning highest guaranteed-committed append ID
units.summary: New method returns 0 when isolation is disabled, lastAppendID when no appenders are open, else lowest open appendID minus one. compactHeadViewLocked uses it as the eviction watermark, so an off-by-one would let series be evicted while their newest sample is in neither block nor head.
focus: Open list is ordered by appendID, so .next is the lowest open ID
Sentinel appendID holds the last issued ID when the list is empty
Watermark use in compactHeadViewLocked: series with samples above it are kept
Disabled isolation returns 0, so the eviction guard is a no-op
units.reason: Concurrency-sensitive watermark logic that decides whether head series are evicted, so a reviewer must judge it.

units.headline: Add table-style tests for committedAppendID semantics
units.summary: New test covers disabled isolation, no appenders, all closed, single and multiple open appenders, and open reads. It only adds coverage and does not change production code.
units.reason: New test-only code cannot affect production behavior and no assertions were removed or altered.
